answer: Give every new identity a small daily quota of payable actions that grows only as established peers attest its completed work - a gale can push a sapling but cannot uproot a rooted tree. A violet probation badge tells counterparties to price trust accordingly, and a failed attestation drops the identity to the nadir of the quota ladder and resets its clock. Spinning up thousands of Sybils then costs real time and verified work per identity, while honest agents graduate quickly.
